name: Data Detective
desc: Sharpest evidence of the day: clean data and an inference that holds up.

name: Safety Captain
desc: Ran the station with PPE on and zero safety flags.

name: Prototype MVP
desc: The build that carried the team: reliable and well made.

name: Best Teammate
desc: Lifted the whole crew across the rotating roles.

name: Best Redesign
desc: Changed one variable and measurably improved the result.

name: Cleanest Cleanup
desc: Left the bench spotless and the materials reset.

name: Most Creative Design
desc: The most original approach that still met the win condition.

name: Comeback of the Day
desc: Earned the comeback bonus: a 20-point redesign gain or a strong evidence defense.
